regulation: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 June 2024 (Artificial Intelligence Act), OJ L, 2024/1689, 12.7.2024

scope.transitional_status: No transitional limitation identified from the submitted facts.

findings.title: High-risk: Creditworthiness evaluation and credit scoring
findings.detail: Annex III high-risk area (Art. 6(2) AIA); no derogation asserted.

obligations.title: Risk management system
obligations.requirement: Establish, document and maintain a continuous risk management system.

obligations.title: Data and data governance
obligations.requirement: Apply data governance to training, validation and testing data sets.

obligations.title: Technical documentation
obligations.requirement: Draw up technical documentation (Annex IV) before placing on the market.

obligations.title: Record-keeping (logging)
obligations.requirement: Enable automatic recording of events (logs) over the system's lifetime.

obligations.title: Transparency to deployers
obligations.requirement: Provide instructions for use enabling deployers to comply.

obligations.title: Human oversight
obligations.requirement: Design the system for effective oversight by natural persons.

obligations.title: Accuracy, robustness, cybersecurity
obligations.requirement: Achieve appropriate accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity.

obligations.title: Quality management system
obligations.requirement: Put a quality management system in place.

obligations.title: Conformity assessment
obligations.requirement: Undergo the applicable conformity assessment before market placement.

obligations.title: EU declaration of conformity
obligations.requirement: Draw up and keep an EU declaration of conformity.

obligations.title: CE marking
obligations.requirement: Affix the CE marking to indicate conformity.

obligations.title: Registration
obligations.requirement: Register the system in the EU database before market placement.

obligations.title: Serious incident reporting
obligations.requirement: Report serious incidents to the market surveillance authority.

documentation_required.title: Technical documentation
documentation_required.requirement: Annex IV technical documentation, kept current.

documentation_required.title: Risk management file
documentation_required.requirement: Documented risk management system and its results.

documentation_required.title: QMS documentation
documentation_required.requirement: Written quality management system policies and procedures.

timeline.note: GPAI obligations apply from 2 August 2025 (Art. 113(b) AIA).

timeline.provision: General application for provisions without a later specific date
timeline.note: The general application date remains 2 August 2026, subject to the later dates introduced by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744.
Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 sets 2 December 2027 for the relevant Annex III high-risk system provisions.
Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 sets 2 August 2028 for the relevant product-embedded high-risk system provisions.
